title: On a class of combinatorial group invariants
summary: In this paper, we explore group invariants arising from combinatorial structures associated with finite groups, including the functional graphs of power maps and the well-studied power graphs. These invariants induce equivalence relations (and hence partitions) on the set of isomorphism classes of finite groups, which we classify from the finest to the coarsest. Surprisingly, all but three of these partitions turn out to coincide; for the subclass of nilpotent groups, all but two coincide.
